parameters.description:
Aion 3.0 Mini is a compact multi-model storytelling system from Aion Labs, bringing collaborative generation to a lighter, cheaper footprint.

Built on the DeepSeek model family (released May 2026), Aion 3.0 Mini uses a collaborative generation process in which multiple specialized models contribute to each response for stronger narrative structure and a nuanced treatment of mature themes. It is reasoning-capable with a 131K-token context and is served OpenAI-compatibly through the UnitySVC gateway, which relays your chat-completion requests to the AionLabs API and meters usage per token.

Call it in either the OpenAI or Anthropic API style — the gateway auto-detects the dialect and translates as needed. Two channels share one endpoint: `managed` (pay per token using the platform's key, nothing to configure) and `byok` (bring your own AionLabs key and route free). See the code examples and "How to use this model" for setup.

details.multimodal: Not multimodal — optimized for text-only tasks
details.reasoning: Reasoning-capable; optimized for immersive roleplay and storytelling
details.strengths: Narrative structure and nuanced handling of mature themes at a lighter footprint
